trustPage.title: Trust and security
trustPage.description: How Formalie protects your data: the controls in place today, your rights and our commitments, and how to report a problem.
trustPage.metaDescription: Workspaces kept apart in the database, encryption everywhere, roles and single sign-on, an audit trail, tested backups and privacy by default.

items.title: Every workspace kept apart, in the database itself
items.text: Each workspace's data is separated by rules inside the database (row-level security on every table), not only by the application, and automated tests check it on every change.

items.title: Encrypted everywhere
items.text: All traffic is encrypted. The app's own requests carry a second layer of encryption on top. Stored credentials, two-step secrets and backups are encrypted with keys kept apart from each other.

items.title: You control who sees what
items.text: Roles with per-form sharing, two-step sign-in, single sign-on (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, OneLogin, SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect), allowed networks and session limits for each workspace.

items.title: Every change on record
items.text: Each workspace has an audit trail of who changed what, when and from where, including anything Formalie staff do.

items.title: Formalie staff need your permission
items.text: Support can open your workspace only when an admin allows it, for 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days, read only unless you allow changes, and you can end it at any time.

items.title: Your data, your database
items.text: Keep responses in Formalie, or have them written straight into your own PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server or Oracle database.

items.title: Backups that are tested
items.text: Encrypted backups, with restores tested before launch and every month after.

items.title: Abuse kept out
items.text: Limits on sign-in attempts and on every request, checks against automated form submissions, and caps on emails sent to any one address.

items.title: Payments without card details
items.text: Card details are entered with our payment provider and never reach Formalie.

items.title: Privacy by default
items.text: No advertising, no selling of data, no tracking cookies, and request logs kept 30 days in the live service.
